notes: *Asahel* fuses its two source tokens because the ASV writes one word, while *Beth lehem* is split because it writes two (rules 2, 30).
`baššəlōšîm` is the predicate of a verbless clause, so it carries both the copula (rule 49) and the partitive *one of*, no other morpheme licensing that expression (rule 15).
*of Beth-lehem* writes no preposition in the Hebrew; the supplied *of* belongs to the bare nominal (rule 33).
